# Decision 0079: May the critical path use four implementation Actions while the disposable rehearsal retains exactly three?

## Options

- **Approve four implementation Actions** (recommended): Keep both accepted prerequisite identities and all twelve criteria unchanged; use persist-inactive-production-configuration, enroll-session-through-governed-host-request, make-one-plan-serial-execution-durable and prove-installed-three-action-autonomous-rehearsal as four actual implementation records. Prepare the two missing Actions through Agent Asks and select saved configuration through a separately previewed canonical pointer transition. Each Action keeps its own candidate, session, completion, PR/review/checks, permitted merge and installation. The disposable Plan autonomous-three-action-rehearsal still has exactly write-start-marker, transform-start-marker and verify-final-rehearsal. This answers only the record-count exception; it creates no Action, changes no pointer or queue, approves no packet, activates no production and grants no live rehearsal.

## Rationale

The primary brief requires exactly three implementation Actions. Reusing the two canonically accepted prerequisite identities plus separate durable execution and installed-host rehearsal yields four actual records. Read-only planner /root/scope_planner and adversary /root/scope_adversary found that folding full durable five-role execution into enrollment is not defensibly session-sized: missing migrated requirement/input/attempt lineage, atomic bounded retries retaining prior failures, distinct principal/reviewer identity, local exact-head candidate review and QA, criteria/evidence invalidation, and worker completion/integration consumers cross the existing broker, database, planning, Session, QA and production paths. Existing dependency dispatch, leases/admission, restart recovery, deterministic QA readiness and Off fences are reusable. Combining durable implementation and installed proof in the last Action would require installation before same-candidate completion/publication and risks a later split creating a fourth record. The bounded recommendation is an explicit four-record exception, not counting four records as three stages. No workflow DSL, dashboard redesign, multi-project scheduling, notification or broad cleanup machinery is included. Preserve prove-literal-split-browser-and-ledger open. The accepted prerequisite settlement and exact two commits are already published; receipt artifacts/generated/operator-scripts/runs/20261002T164449Z-98726/publication.json is retained. Scope approval remains separate from newly authorized immutable packets and from the fresh exact one-shot live rehearsal Grant. If the operator rejects this recommendation, do not silently consolidate or weaken criteria: obtain a concretely session-sized three-record design first.
